summary: Sound stage 1: moves the FFN boundary (399-402 us at T=16384, ~1.2x its byte floor) off the critical path rather than making it faster (unlike norm-boundaries-persistent-multirow). Its prepare gate is its own A/B, so no companion. Weakest link: whether a 512-thread boundary CTA can share an SM with nvjet 192x192 CTAs at all; if not, overlap is only SM-level interleaving and wave tails, and M2 may gate OFF.
justification: Boundary kernels 813 us at first_turn (~1.2x memory floor); ~1.54-1.61 GB per boundary checks out, so a faster rewrite cannot pay (norm-boundaries-persistent-multirow neutral, Do-not-try); hiding is a different mechanism. nvjet GEMMs ~78% of peak (compute-bound), a good pairing. Missing prior field: norm-boundaries-persistent-multirow, qkv-gate-columns-side-stream-under-attention (1.4512 flat), turn-align-remap-on-side-stream-under-pooler, moe-align-side-stream. WEAKEST LINK: nvjet 192x192x64 4-stage coop likely fills smem and registers, so a 512-thread bnd_rows CTA may not co-reside; overlap then relies on the block scheduler handing retiring SMs to boundary CTAs. NCH=2 leaves the last ~200 us chunk exposed; chunking adds wave tails and may change the cuBLAS tile at M=4096/8192. Realistic -100..-250 us per first_turn row (~0.3-0.7% headline), below the 1.24% margin: read on M1/M2 and replaced rows. Prepare budget is 300 s (not 200); base is now f4751fc0 (kernel_fn tail unchanged).
confounders: sglang-pipeline-parity: defines state['ffn_boundary'] and the dispatch unpooler call replaced here; parity tolerances against that module.
experts-turn-rega-s4-first-turn-n128 / combo-a-master-normgather-naive-stack: rega's L2 footprint precedes the unpooler in the judge, not in the flushed prepare gate (M2 vs M3 may differ).
router side-stream overlap (stack-tonight-five-prefill lineage): only in-layer precedent for block-scheduler overlap; no direct interaction.
interference: No companion: in-process captured-graph A/B (master tail vs chunked tail at NCH 2/4, flushed, interleaved, empty-graph baseline subtracted), M1 print, PATH CHOSEN. Add inside the gate: two interleaved rounds with an IQR bound; a high-priority bnd_stream (torch.cuda.Stream(priority=-1)) and whether capture keeps priority; a capped-grid persistent bnd_rows variant (16-32 CTAs) vs one CTA per row.
rules_flags: None blocking: record_stream outside capture only; shape-sized torch.empty outputs; shape-only routing (T > MARLIN_MAX_TOKENS + prepare flag).
Coefficients per state, never module globals or process-global pointers in the load_inline module.
Precision matches SGLang (fp32 stream, bf16 out_next); write out_stream, never data['stream'] in place.
